Class ContainerKeys

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.containers.api.slot.ContainerKeys
public final class ContainerKeys extends Object
The server-tier key whose seam is Containers' own. The slot author's other rules are MenuKit's since 6.0.0 (BehaviorKeys.GATING, BINDING), enforced by MenuKit at vanilla's seams for every slot kind (§0064). Mending stays here because its seam, the XP orb, is Containers' (ExperienceOrbMendMixin).
